test_title: PYST 35: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 12 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

He says to Gayatri, “You are writing an apology to the warden.”

options.text: He told Gayatri that she is writing an apology to the warden.
He tells Gayatri that she is writing an apology to the warden.
He says to Gayatri that she was writing an apology to the warden.
He tells Gayatri that she was writing an apology to the warden.

solution:
The correct answer is '**He tells Gayatri that she is writing an apology to the warden.'**
